# Expected — 08 crypto-payroll

| Field | Value |
|---|---|
| Type | scam |
| Family | Jobs |
| Expected label | **Scam markers: 3 or more** |
| Recovery branch | no |
| Purpose | The pay-to-be-paid pattern: crypto as payroll, with an activation payment to receive wages — tests that the kit reads the payment's *direction*, not just its form |

## Markers that MUST appear (each quoted from the message)

| Category | Must quote |
|---|---|
| Payment shape | "Send a one-time activation of 0.005 USDT to our registration address" — paying to receive pay |
| Process anomaly | wages in USDT to a wallet the worker must register by paying first — real payroll never charges an activation |
| Urgency | "Registration must be completed before Friday to be included in the next pay cycle" |

## Markers that must NOT appear

- Information extraction — no ID or credentials requested; do not invent them.
- Isolation — the message arrives by email with no off-platform move; do not invent one.

## Guards

- The report's mechanism sentence: the 0.005 USDT is the entire take; wallet addresses are irreversible, which is why the ask is crypto.
- The small amount must not soften the reading — the pattern is the payment's direction (worker pays employer-side address), not its size.
- Verify checklist, no verdict.
